
  const ARAC_KISIM_IMG = 'data:image/png;base64,';
  const yazdir = window.open('', '_blank');
  yazdir.document.write(`
    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html>
    <head>
      <meta charset="UTF-8">
      <title>Malzeme Yerleşim Manifestosu</title>
      <style>
        * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
        body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background: #fff; color: #000; }
        .page { width: 210mm; min-height: 297mm; padding: 12mm 10mm; margin: 0 auto; }
        .baslik-wrap { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 15px; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; padding-bottom: 10px; }
        .baslik-dernek { font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; }
        .baslik-alt { font-size: 14px; color: #333; margin-top: 4px; }
        .tarih-kutu { font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; border: 1px solid #000; padding: 5px 12px; text-align:center; white-space:nowrap; }
        .baslik-cizgi { border:none; border-top:2px solid #000; margin:16px 0; }
        .manifesto-baslik { font-size:16px; font-weight:800; text-align:center; margin-bottom:16px; }
        .kisim-blok { margin-bottom:20px; }
        .kisim-baslik { font-size:13px; font-weight:800; margin-bottom:6px; }
        .kisim-cizgi { border:none; border-top:2px solid #000; margin-bottom:8px; }
        .malzeme-satir { font-size:11px; padding:4px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd; }
        .bos { color:#999; font-size:11px; }
        @media print { body { margin:0; } .page { padding:10mm 8mm; } @page { size:A4 portrait; margin:8mm; } }
      </style>
    </head>
    <body>
      <div class="page">

        <div class="baslik-wrap">
          <img src="${DAK_LOGO_PNG}" alt="DAK Logo" style="height:95px;width:auto;margin-right:12px;">
          <div style="flex:1;text-align:center;">
            <div class="baslik-dernek">DORLION ARAMA VE KURTARMA DERNEĞİ</div>
            <div class="baslik-alt">MALZEME YERLEŞİM MANİFESTOSU</div>
          </div>
          <div class="tarih-kutu">TARİH: ${tarih}</div>
        </div>

        <!-- Araç görseli sağda, araç bilgisi solda -->
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:16px;gap:16px;">
          <div style="flex:1;">
            ${aracHtml}
          </div>
          ${aracImgSrc ? `
          <div>
            <div style="text-align:center;margin:16px 0;">
          <img src="${ARAC_KISIM_IMG}" style="max-width:420px;width:100%;border-radius:6px;">
        </div>

        <div class="manifesto-baslik">Malzeme Yerleşim Manifestosu</div>
        <hr class="baslik-cizgi">

        ${kisimlarHtml}

      </div>

      <script>
        window.onload = function() { window.print(); };
      <\/script>
    </body>
    </html>
  `);
  yazdir.document.close();

  showToast('✅ Malzeme Yer Manifestosu hazırlandı!', 'success');
}

function malzemeManifestoGoster() {
  const m = mevkutManifesto;

  let onizlemeHtml = `
    <div style="background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:20px;margin-bottom:24px;">
      <div style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:20px;">
        <div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:8px;">📄 ARAÇ VE MALZEME MANİFESTOSU</div>
        <div style="color:var(--text2);font-size:13px;">
          <strong>Operasyon:</strong> ${m.operasyonAdi}<br>
          <strong>Tarih:</strong> ${m.tarih} ${m.saat}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style="background:var(--surface);border-radius:8px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:14px;">
        <div style="font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:10px;">🚗 Taşıyıcı Araç Bilgileri</div>
        <table style="width:100%;font-size:12px;">
          <tr><td style="color:var(--text3);">Plaka:</td><td style="font-weight:700;">${m.arac.plaka}</td><td style="color:var(--text3);">Marka:</td><td style="font-weight:700;">${m.arac.marka}</td></tr>
          <tr><td style="color:var(--text3);">Model:</td><td style="font-weight:700;">${m.arac.model}</td><td style="color:var(--text3);">Cinsi:</td><td style="font-weight:700;">${m.arac.cinsi}</td></tr>
          <tr><td style="color:var(--text3);">Rengi:</td><td style="font-weight:700;">${m.arac.rengi}</td><td></td><td></td></tr>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  document.getElementById('malzemeManifestoOnizleme').innerHTML = onizlemeHtml;
 
  // Malzeme tablosu
  let toplamAgirlik = 0;
  let toplamHacim = 0;

  m.malzemeler.forEach(ml => {
    toplamAgirlik += parseFloat(ml.agirlik) || 0;
    toplamHacim += parseFloat(ml.hacim) || 0;
  });

  let tabloHtml = `
    <div style="background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:20px;margin-bottom:24px;overflow-x:auto;">
      <div style="font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:14px;font-size:15px;">📦 MALZEMELİ LİSTESİ</div>
      <table style="width:100%;font-size:12px;border-collapse:collapse;">
        <thead>
          <tr style="background:var(--surface);border-bottom:2px solid var(--border);">
            <th style="padding:10px;text-align:left;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;">SIRA</th>
            <th style="padding:10px;text-align:left;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;">MALZEME ADI</th>
            <th style="padding:10px;text-align:left;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;">KOD</th>
            <th style="padding:10px;text-align:left;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;">MODELİ</th>
            <th style="padding:10px;text-align:left;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;">CİNSİ</th>
            <th style="padding:10px;text-align:left;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;">ADEDİ</th>
            <th style="padding:10px;text-align:left;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;">DURUMU</th>
            <th style="padding:10px;text-align:left;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;">AĞIRLIK</th>
            <th style="padding:10px;text-align:left;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;">DEP.HACMİ</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
  `;

  m.malzemeler.forEach((ml, index) => {
    tabloHtml += `
      <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);">
        <td style="padding:10px;">${index + 1}</td>
        <td style="padding:10px;font-weight:700;">${ml.adi}</td>
        <td style="padding:10px;">${ml.kod}</td>
        <td style="padding:10px;">${ml.model || '-'}</td>
        <td style="padding:10px;">${ml.cinsi}</td>
        <td style="padding:10px;text-align:center;">${ml.adedi}</td>
        <td style="padding:10px;"><span class="badge badge-${ml.durumu === 'FAAL' ? 'active' : 'passive'}">${ml.durumu}</span></td>
        <td style="padding:10px;text-align:right;">${ml.agirlik} kg</td>
        <td style="padding:10px;text-align:right;">${ml.hacim} m³</td>
      </tr>
    `;
  });

  tabloHtml += `
      <tr style="background:rgba(59,130,246,0.1);font-weight:700;border-top:2px solid var(--accent);">
        <td colspan="7" style="padding:10px;text-align:right;">TOPLAM:</td>
        <td style="padding:10px;text-align:right;">${toplamAgirlik.toFixed(2)} kg</td>
        <td style="padding:10px;text-align:right;">${toplamHacim.toFixed(2)} m³</td>
      </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  `;

  document.getElementById('malzemeManifestoTablo').innerHTML = tabloHtml;
}

function malzemeManifestoPdfIndir() {
  if (!mevkutManifesto) {
    showToast('❌ Önce manifesto oluşturunuz!', 'error');
    return;
  }

  const m = mevkutManifesto;
  const printWindow = window.open('', '_blank');
  
  let toplamAgirlik = 0;
  let toplamHacim = 0;
  m.malzemeler.forEach(ml => {
    toplamAgirlik += parseFloat(ml.agirlik) || 0;
    toplamHacim += parseFloat(ml.hacim) || 0;
  });

  const malzemeRows = m.malzemeler.map((ml, idx) => `
    <tr>
      <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;text-align:center;">${idx + 1}</td>
      <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;">${ml.adi}</td>
      <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;">${ml.kod}</td>
      <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;">${ml.model || '-'}</td>
      <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;">${ml.cinsi}</td>
      <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;text-align:center;">${ml.adedi}</td>
      <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;text-align:center;">${ml.durumu}</td>
      <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;text-align:right;">${ml.agirlik} kg</td>
      <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;text-align:right;">${ml.hacim} m³</td>
    </tr>
  `).join('');

  const html = `
    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html>
    <head>
      <meta charset="UTF-8">
      <title>Araç ve Malzeme Manifestosu</title>
      <style>
        * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
        body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background: #fff; color: #000; }
        
        .page { 
          width: 210mm; 
          min-height: 297mm; 
          padding: 12mm 10mm; 
          margin: 0 auto 20mm auto; 
          page-break-after: always;
        }

        .baslik-wrap { 
          display: flex; 
          justify-content: space-between; 
          align-items: center; 
          margin-bottom: 15px; 
          border-bottom: 2px solid #000; 
          padding-bottom: 10px; 
        }
        .baslik-dernek { 
          font-size: 16px; 
          font-weight: bold; 
          text-transform: uppercase; 
        }
        .baslik-alt { 
          font-size: 14px; 
          color: #333; 
        }
        .tarih-kutu { 
          font-size: 11px; 
          font-weight: bold; 
          border: 1px solid #000; 
          padding: 5px 12px; 
        }

        .arac-bilgi {
          background: #f8f9fa;
          border: 1px solid #000;
          padding: 10px;
          margin-bottom: 15px;
          font-size: 10.5px;
        }

        table { 
          width: 100%; 
          border-collapse: collapse; 
          font-size: 9.5px; 
        }
        th, td { 
          border: 1px solid #000; 
          padding: 5px 4px; 
          text-align: center; 
        }
        th { 
          background: #e0e0e0; 
          font-weight: bold; 
        }
        .total-row { 
          font-weight: bold; 
          background: #f0f0f0; 
        }

        @media print {
          body { margin: 0; }
          .page { padding: 10mm 8mm; }
          @page { 
            size: A4 portrait;
            margin: 8mm;
          }
        }
      </style>
    </head>
    <body>
      <div class="page">
        <div class="baslik-wrap">
          <img src="${DAK_LOGO_PNG}" alt="DAK Logo" style="height:95px;width:auto;margin-right:12px;">
          <div style="flex:1;text-align:center;">
            <div class="baslik-dernek">DORLION ARAMA VE KURTARMA DERNEĞİ</div>
            <div class="baslik-alt">ARAÇ VE MALZEME MANİFESTOSU</div>
          </div>
          <div class="tarih-kutu">TARİH: ${m.tarih}</div>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-bottom:10px;">
          <strong>Operasyon Adı:</strong> ${m.operasyonAdi || '-'}
        </div>

        <!-- ARAÇ BİLGİLERİ -->
        <div class="arac-bilgi">
          <strong>Taşıyan Araç Bilgileri</strong><br>
          <strong>Plaka:</strong> ${m.arac.plaka || '-'} &nbsp;&nbsp;
          <strong>Marka/Model:</strong> ${m.arac.marka || ''} ${m.arac.model || ''} &nbsp;&nbsp;
          <strong>Cinsi:</strong> ${m.arac.cinsi || '-'}<br>
          <strong>Rengi:</strong> ${m.arac.rengi || '-'}
        </div>

        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>SIRA</th>
              <th>MALZEME ADI</th>
              <th>KOD</th>
              <th>MODEL</th>
              <th>CİNSİ</th>
              <th>ADEDİ</th>
              <th>DURUMU</th>
              <th>AĞIRLIK (kg)</th>
              <th>HACİM (m³)</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            ${malzemeRows}
            <tr class="total-row">
              <td colspan="7" style="text-align:right;"><strong>TOPLAM</strong></td>
              <td><strong>${toplamAgirlik.toFixed(2)} kg</strong></td>
              <td><strong>${toplamHacim.toFixed(2)} m³</strong></td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </body>
    </html>`;

  printWindow.document.write(html);
  printWindow.document.close();
  setTimeout(() => {
    printWindow.print();
  }, 250);

  showToast('✅ Manifesto PDF hazırlandı!', 'success');
}

</script>
</div><!-- /#app -->
</body>
</html>
